title: Bali Family Getaway
headline: Ubud for a few days, then a beach stay the children will remember.
description: A six-night family holiday in Bali: culture and rice country first, then a coastal hotel with a pool and easy evenings.
image_alt: Turquoise water and cliffs on the Bali coast
price_label: Quoted for your family and dates
price_guidance: Family pricing depends on room configuration, child ages and whether a water park or Tanah Lot evening is included. International flights sit outside this figure unless you ask us to ticket them.
overview: Two stays so you are not packing every morning. Ubud introduces temples and terraces at a child’s pace; Nusa Dua or a similar resort coast closes the week with a beach and a proper pool. Private transfers throughout.
highlights: Three nights in Ubud with one gentle culture morning.
Family rooms or interconnecting rooms requested where possible.
Three nights on a resort coast with beach and pool time.
Optional water park or Tanah Lot, if you add it to the quote.
why: Culture and a beach week without a long island-hop.
Daily load can be cut for younger children.
The same concierge handles stays, drivers and any park tickets.
inclusions: Accommodation on twin or family-room sharing as quoted
One private half-day Ubud driver as quoted
exclusions: Water-park tickets, Tanah Lot and paid shows unless added
Personal expenses, GST and tourism fees

stay.name: Selected family-friendly hotels in Ubud and on the south coast
stay.room: Twin, double or interconnecting rooms as available
amenities: Resort pool at the beach stay

notes: Room types, driver days and attraction tickets are confirmed in writing. Some temples close for ceremonies. An inquiry is not a booking.
itinerary_note: Suggested family order: Ubud, then Nusa Dua or Sanur. A stay can be lengthened if you prefer more beach than culture.
